sentences.en: The strength of the chain is in the weakest link.
sentences.zh: 链条的强度在于最弱的那个环节。

sentences.en: Letters are a link with friends who live far away.
sentences.zh: 信件是与远方朋友联系的方式。

sentences.en: Permalinks are basically links to items like posts, comments, etc.
sentences.zh: 永久链接基本上就是指向文章、评论等项的链接。

senses.zh: 环，节；计算机链接；关联，关系

mnemonic: 联想记忆：网络上的“链接”就叫link→连接，联系
